channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Rocky Mount - Estate Sale
item.description: Estate Sale. Indoor. Saturday February 14th. 8am to 2pm. 7998 West Mount Dr Rocky Mount. Vintage items. New items. Furniture. Clothes. Bring your Valentine....

item.title: CCS girls win MACAA middle school crown
item.description: Top-seeded Community Christian School girls capped a 13-1 season by winning the MACAA middle school title, beating Trinity Christian and New Bern Christian, and earning the league’s Most Christ-like Team award.

item.title: Trojans finish unbeaten county run as Vikes brace for battle again
item.description: Darden’s boys cap an unbeaten Wilson County run with a 46-34 win over Elm City, while the Vikings regroup for a Forest Hills play-in as Elm City’s girls edge Darden 28-22 in OT.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Chargers hit new high in rout of Christ Covenant
item.description: Wilson Christian boys hit a season-high 73 in a rout of Christ Covenant, while the Lady Chargers and JV girls also earn home wins before closing the regular season at Alamance Christian.

item.title: Railroad crossings to close for upkeep
item.description: Fifteen railroad crossings in Wilson County, including downtown Wilson and nearby Elm City and Sharpsburg, will close to vehicle traffic for a few days as CSX performs track and crossing tie maintenance.

item.title: 7 pounds of meth seized in Lucama raid
item.description: A multi-agency raid in Lucama led to the seizure of more than 7 pounds of methamphetamine; a Lucama man was charged with Level 3 trafficking and maintaining a dwelling for drug sales before posting $300,000 bond.

item.title: Pink Ladies help with mammogram costs
item.description: The Pink Ladies continue their support of local breast cancer patients and survivors.

item.title: ‘Old-fashioned newspaperman’: Former reporters pay tribute to Hal Tarleton
item.description: Former Wilson Times reporters remember former editor Hal Tarleton, who died Sunday, as a tough, well-respected journalist and mentor whose standards and community focus still shape their work.

item.title: Wilson man arrested in cemetery incursion
item.description: Wilson police arrested 25-year-old David Lopez, accused of driving through city-owned Vick Cemetery after Sunday’s snowfall and defacing a grave.

item.title: BEST Center could open next year
item.description: Wilson Community College reports steady progress on its new BEST Center at Campus at 587 and increased enrollment.
